_about: Floors for scripts/eval_staging.py. `rules` is checked offline by tests/services/shot_producer/test_eval_staging.py. `model` is empty until a run with OPENAI__API_KEY records it (--update-thresholds). The two rules-mode misses are the unmarked calls: only the intent agent can catch them. `ceilings` are counts that must stay at or under the number given, in every mode (plan/2026-11-01b): shots that hold more than they can show, a voice heard before its source is shown, a thought that reaches the camera. info_carried is a floor like the rest. plan/2026-11-01d adds button_present and breath_band (floors, rules mode) and turn_unseen, teleport and line_crossed (ceilings, every mode); inner_as_behaviour is a floor for model mode only, because the free rules leave a story note as narration.
